text:
lina: Quick note 1 working on a short 'autoscale playbook' page that collects the tiny examples we scatter across provisioning docs. Aim: one page with YAML, TF mapping, Node/Python SDKs, and a short FAQ about eviction/isolation. Pulling together a PR now. @arjun @emily any must-haves?

arjun: Please include a tiny flow diagram (we can link an SVG) and a table that maps policy types -> expected latency/cost tradeoffs.

emily: Add a short troubleshooting section: common causes when autoscale doesn't add instances (label mismatch, quota, warmup window). I've got one-liners for each.

lina: Good. Draft will include sections: overview, steady vs burst, reserved-pool example, tenant labels & eviction priority, SDK + TF samples, troubleshooting.

samir: For eviction example, show explicit label mapping: isolation: dedicated -> eviction_score=0 (lowest eviction), isolation: shared -> eviction_score=100. Also mention that reserved pools are SLA-backed.

devon: Linkcheck often flags our old TF anchors. If you add a TF snippet, point to the new handbook anchor: /docs/dedicated/provisioning#terraform-reference.

lina: I'll use that anchor. Small burst YAML to include (copy/paste ok):

```yaml
scalePolicy:
  id: burst-a1
  type: reactive
  targets:
    cpu: 0.75
  burst:
    max_instances: 8
    cooldown: 45s
  labels:
    tenant: "data-team"
```

emily: I'll draft the Node + Python quick snippets and post here in a sec.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4402 - autoscale-playbook. CI: lint OK, linkcheck: 1 warning (svg path).

arjun: I'll host the SVG in the docs assets bucket and update the PR once the asset is uploaded.

lina: Thanks all. Tagging reviewers: @devon @samir @emily. Prefer to merge after the SVG + anchor fix. ETA tomorrow morning. :rocket:
